canonical_bytes.array_hash_preimage: exact raw C-order bytes with no header, filename, shape prefix, or terminal LF
canonical_bytes.artifact_hash: SHA-256 of complete exact artifact bytes
canonical_bytes.receipt_hash: SHA-256 of complete canonical JSON receipt bytes

g5a_receipt_root.commitment: the existing temporac.g5a-receipt.v4 receipt_root_sha256 is SHA-256 of these exact canonical JSON bytes
g5a_receipt_root.index_binding: certified_development_index_bytes is the positive exact byte count and certified_development_index_sha256 hashes the complete index bytes

receipt_inventory.multiplicity: one entry per receipt artifact in the frozen inventory; identical digests retain multiplicity

row_rules: rows are strictly ordered with no duplicate identity
rows contain every and only the frozen K1/G5a certified development identities
opaque_key_hex and component_key_hex are lowercase 32-byte hex
slot is the exact nonnegative development local-person slot
all rows bind the one exact selection receipt and selected checkpoint artifact/receipt
component_key_hex equals the exact frozen population-manifest component key for the same identity and is not caller-selectable
feature and target receipts validate against their named exact artifacts and identity
natural input validates against the exact feature and selection
target source kind is natural and every teacher digest equals selected_checkpoint_artifact_sha256

k7_replay.before: vault unit checks and every metric calculation
steps: verify G5a receipt_root_sha256 against exact g5a receipt-root-index bytes and verify certified-development index bytes/hash
load and validate exact feature artifact and feature receipt

reload the complete score index, all checkpoint and run receipts, exact selection receipt, and exact selected checkpoint artifact/receipt; reconstruct SelectedTeacher and require its code/environment bindings to equal G5a
rerun canonical natural inference and require rebuilt natural-input receipt bytes to equal indexed bytes
bind the certificate track, rerun certify_target, and require CERTIFIED
rebuild the unchanged seven-member target NPZ and unchanged ten-key target receipt
require rebuilt target NPZ bytes and target receipt bytes to be bytewise identical to indexed artifacts
k7_replay.swap_rule: same identity and teacher with a different feature, natural input, teacher, selection, target artifact, or target receipt fails

archive_rules.deterministic_writer: the fixed-metadata deterministic_npz_bytes algorithm bound by src/pams/temporac/hashio.py

checkpoint_artifact.teacher_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of the complete exact 16-member checkpoint artifact bytes

checkpoint_receipt.replay_binding: code_sha256 and environment_sha256 also equal the existing G5a code/environment commitments; config_sha256 remains the exact selected teacher-run configuration commitment
checkpoint_receipt.run_binding: artifact_sha256 equals ordered_checkpoint_sha256[step/500-1] in the exact successful teacher run receipt, and code/config/environment/job/seed match that receipt

builder_required_inputs: exact feature receipt bytes and expected digest

f5.continuous: C-order <f8[T,149] formed once from canonical teacher_input[:,0:149]
f5.equal_traversal_aggregation: Neumaier sum traversal means and second moments in traversal order, divide by integer traversal count
f5.neumaier_update: for each x: t=s+x; if abs(s)>=abs(x), compensation+=(s-t)+x, else compensation+=(x-t)+s; s=t; result=s+compensation
f5.static_cast: exactly one complete C-order cast from <f8[298] to <f4[298]
f5.subedge_order: left-to-right base-edge subedges within each traversal

landmark_precheck.traversals: same-run consecutive landmarks only, concatenated in run order

natural_input_receipt.static_and_traversal_evidence: independently rederived from the exact feature, not trusted from receipt

order: validate typed feature against exact feature artifact/receipt
derive geometry-only integer landmarks per run and immediately LANDMARK-abstain if any run has fewer than three
compute normative binary64 Neumaier F5 static vector
cast static vector once to float32 and perform one canonical CPU teacher forward
validate float32 outputs then cast once to C-order <f8 phase/reconstruction and hash

output_casts.phase: float32 model output validated then exactly one C-order cast to <f8[T,2]
output_casts.reconstruction: float32 model output validated then exactly one C-order cast to <f8[T,149]

rules: exactly three seeds and all forty 500-step checkpoints per seed
six score values equal the six non-payload TeacherCheckpointScore fields
negative_edge_fraction is in [0,1] and tune_abstentions is a nonnegative integer
checkpoint_receipt_sha256 binds the same seed and step
duplicate, missing, extra, or mismatched rows fail globally

construction_inputs: exact globally selected checkpoint artifact bytes
selected_teacher_loader.digest_source: recomputed selected checkpoint artifact bytes only
load_rules: verify every hash, closed schema, complete inventory, run binding, and selection result
instantiate a fresh current TempoRACTeacher on CPU
reject every key, shape, or dtype not in the exact 16-member table
reserialize through the same deterministic NPZ writer and require exact input byte equality
set eval mode before exposing the typed SelectedTeacher

selection_receipt.rejection_rule: discard negative_edge_fraction greater than 0.01; fail when a seed has no remaining checkpoint
selection_receipt.verifier: reloads all 120 rows and their checkpoint receipts, recomputes the three winners and global winner, and bytewise checks every recorded digest

consumer_order: validate the Mapping against the exact six-key P05M receipt schema
internally materialize a plain dictionary from the six validated keys
canonicalize and hash that internal dictionary
mapping_composition.malformed_mapping_rule: unknown, missing, or invalid values fail before hashing
mapping_composition.required_byte_equality: internal canonical bytes equal canonical bytes for a normal dictionary containing the same six key/value pairs

Cdev.definition: ordered identity projection frozen at K1 and committed by the certified-development index at G5a
required_equal_sequences: actual typed CertifiedDevelopmentTarget evidence identity sequence
Cdev.target_count_rule: each count equals the sum of pulse bits in the bytewise-verified target for the same identity and the existing target-count root uses exactly Cdev rows

P402.definition: ordered identity projection of the frozen population manifest

population_equalities.certification_non_expansion: Cdev need not contain all 134 development identities and never contains all 402 population identities by requirement

purpose: close only Round-2 certificate findings R2-F1 through R2-F4 without expanding algorithm, data, claims, jobs, thresholds, population, target schema, or authority

R2-F1.closure: exact checkpoint bytes, closed receipts, complete selection replay, typed selected teacher, and actual canonical CPU inference
required_evidence: reject altered checkpoint bytes or member metadata
reject non-strict load and noncanonical inference
positive replay reproduces natural output receipt bytes

R2-F2.closure: G5a-committed certified-development index plus K7 reconstruction and bytewise target NPZ/receipt equality with unchanged target schema
required_evidence: same identity/teacher with different feature or natural input target swap fails

R2-F3.closure: exact P402, exact 9648 Cartesian envelopes, exact Cdev evidence/count/index equality, and computed G5b cardinality
required_evidence: prediction subset fails before capability consumption
certified evidence subset fails before capability consumption
target-count subset fails before capability consumption
population/vault mismatch, duplicate, and extra identity fail

R2-F4.closure: consumer validates any Mapping and internally canonicalizes a plain dictionary
required_evidence: direct builder return consumes without caller adaptation
